latestVersion.changelog:
honcho-memory-mux-setup 0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Installs and configures Honcho with @alloralabs/honcho-memory-mux for multiplexed memory retrieval (Honcho-first, local file fallback).
- Migrates legacy memory files to Honcho, preserving file safety and providing clear, classified previews and confirmations.
- Automatically updates workspace agent documentation to explain new memory policies, retrieval order, write behavior, and fallback procedures.
- Adds practical conventions for agent memory handling and supports optional, non-intrusive memory observability reporting.
- Includes guardrails for safe migration, transparent reporting, and reversible changes.
